scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach(f=>{try{fs.unlinkSync(f)}catch(e){}}); const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; const isCI=process.env.CI==='true'; if(!isCI && !/^pnpm\//.test(ua)){console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.build: if command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build; else cd artifacts/prime-haven && npm install && npm run build; fi
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
